comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Tip: most ornaments require a discovery card to craft. You can find the majority of them listed on the Ornaments section to the left; alternatively, look at the discovery and its card may tell you where to make the ornament too. Or, use this link shared by CA-BlakeC for a list of ornament effects (translation from Korean required):

ssjoy.org/dho/installationEffect

Until the ornament pages are updated, those will help you the most. Cheers.
